triggers: grant_events_no_delete ON grant_events: CREATE TRIGGER grant_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON grant_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant_events 只增不改'); END

grant_events_no_replace ON grant_events: CREATE TRIGGER grant_events_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON grant_events WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grant_events WHERE seq = NEW.seq) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant_events 只增不改'); END
grant_events_no_update ON grant_events: CREATE TRIGGER grant_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON grant_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant_events 只增不改'); END

grants_activate_unexpired ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_activate_unexpired BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON grants WHEN NEW.status = 'active' AND OLD.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.expires_at <= CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '已经过了期限的授予不能生效'); END

grants_approver_once ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_approver_once BEFORE UPDATE ON grants WHEN (NEW.approved_by IS NOT OLD.approved_by OR NEW.approved_by_principal IS NOT OLD.approved_by_principal) AND NOT (OLD.status = 'pending' AND NEW.status = 'active') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '放行人只在待核→生效那一步写'); END

grants_expire_when_due ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_expire_when_due BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON grants WHEN NEW.status = 'expired' AND (OLD.expires_at IS NULL OR OLD.expires_at > CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '没到期限的授予不能标成过期'); END

grants_fixed ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_fixed BEFORE UPDATE ON grants WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id OR NEW.role IS NOT OLD.role OR NEW.scope IS NOT OLD.scope OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.reason IS NOT OLD.reason OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by OR NEW.created_by_principal IS NOT OLD.created_by_principal OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '授予的主体、角色、范围、期限、理由、起草人建好就不能改'); END

grants_forward_only ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_forward_only BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON grants WHEN NOT ((OLD.status = 'draft' AND NEW.status IN ('pending','revoked')) OR (OLD.status = 'pending' AND NEW.status IN ('active','revoked')) OR (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status IN ('revoked','expired'))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '授予的状态只能按 草稿→待核→生效→撤销或过期 往前走'); END
grants_no_delete ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON grants BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '授予不删除'); END
grants_no_replace ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON grants WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grants WHERE id = NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '授予不删除，也不能用同一个 id 覆盖'); END
grants_source_fixed ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_source_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF source ON grants WHEN NEW.source IS NOT OLD.source BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '授予的来源建好就不能改'); END

grants_start_draft ON grants: CREATE TRIGGER grants_start_draft BEFORE INSERT ON grants WHEN NEW.status <> 'draft' OR NEW.approved_by IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_by_principal IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, '授予一律从草稿开始'); END

principal_pending_appearance ON principal_pending: CREATE TRIGGER principal_pending_appearance AFTER INSERT ON principal_pending BEGIN INSERT INTO principal_pending_seq (id) VALUES (NULL); UPDATE principal_pending SET appearance = last_insert_rowid() WHERE provider = NEW.provider AND external_id = NEW.external_id; DELETE FROM principal_pending_seq WHERE id < last_insert_rowid(); END

sop_runs_cache_revision ON sop_runs: CREATE TRIGGER sop_runs_cache_revision AFTER UPDATE OF data, status ON sop_runs BEGIN UPDATE sop_runs SET cache_revision = OLD.cache_revision + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id; END

sop_runs_hot_pending_clear ON sop_runs: CREATE TRIGGER sop_runs_hot_pending_clear AFTER UPDATE OF data ON sop_runs WHEN NEW.hot_pending <> 0 BEGIN UPDATE sop_runs SET hot_pending = 0 WHERE id = NEW.id; END
